text_translated_detailed: Two sets of our letters and resolutions for the fatherland, and the day register of our Equipment Master Jacobus Heere, containing the courses and force of the winds along this coast, as well as a letter, together with a packet of papers for the fatherland, sent to us from Banda for forwarding to your High Excellencies, all in a box with its contents described and marked & Also we take in all humility the liberty, your High Excellency under supplication of a favorable disposition to present the following petitions, namely: One from the under merchant Jan Hendrick Voll, most humbly requesting that he be confirmed as quartermaster. One from the under merchant Frederick Willem Henbrick van Blijdenberg requesting that he be confirmed as salary book keeper. One from the under merchant Johan Vermehr begging that he be favored with an appointment. One from the book keeper Jacob Rikkes Bakker, requesting that he be confirmed as salary resident. One from the absolute assistant Abraham Trevizo, requesting that he be confirmed as dispenser. Two from the soldiers at the pen Just Frederick Lodewijk Helmkampff and Hendrick Ritterus Hodenpijl, and to send the one mentioned in the text back hither again. One from the sailor at the pen Johannes Bjookelman, most humbly requesting that he be favored with assistant provisions. Finally we still take the honor your High Excellencies humbly to request that for greater speed, the vessel by which this reaches your High Excellencies, and which we have been forced to requisition / as appears from the attached extract resolution of the 7th hereinbefore:/ be sent back to us as soon as possible. Whereupon your High Excellencies illustrious persons together with the Company's weighty concerns having been commended to God's safe protection, we take the honor to sign ourselves with the utmost veneration and humility /: understood:/ High and Noble, Great and Honorable, Strict, Earnest, Valiant, Wise, Prudent, Most Generous
